questions.text: What is the budget? One number per surface or interaction (LCP, INP, p95 API time, first audio, throughput), and which human limit (0.1 / 1 / 10 s) it serves.
How will I prove it? Which command and environment (built app, stage, never the dev server), how many interleaved runs, and the decision rule, written now.
What does the user see at 100 ms, at 1 s and on failure (pending, skeleton or optimistic state, and an error)?
What stays on screen while this loads? Draw the loading boundaries; the shell must be outside them.
What is the dependency graph of the I/O? Which awaits truly depend on each other? The rest runs in parallel, preloaded or streamed.
How does cost grow with data? Is any read or computation O(all of the user's data) per interaction? Where are the limit, cursor and cache?
What runs on the main thread, and can any task exceed 50 ms? What moves to a worker, a deferred render or a virtualized list?
What serializes? Name every lock, queue and single-flight. Is its key exactly the unit that conflicts?
What happens on the first request after a cold start? Would it pass with retries disabled?

For agent and LLM paths: what is the latency budget for a trivial request? Is any tool forced or any pre-fetch unbudgeted? Are independent tools called in parallel? Pre-mortem: it shipped and it's slow; why?

budgets.measure: Lighthouse CI median of >= 5 runs on the built app or stage; RUM p75 in the field
web-vitals onINP in the field; scripted event duration in the lab
PerformanceObserver longtask on the built app
time from click to pending/optimistic state in an interaction test
log sink bytes / requests under a 100-request load (team sets it)

rules.title: transition: all (animates layout properties off the compositor)
rules.why: Every property change animates, including width/height/top, which costs layout and paint per frame.
rules.confirm: measurement: interaction trace shows Layout/Recalculate Style during the transition
rules.fixHint: transition only transform and opacity (or name the exact properties)

rules.title: Forced tool call (tool_choice any/tool) on a model call
rules.why: Guarantees a tool round-trip even for a trivial question, skips thinking, and some models reject it.
rules.confirm: measurement: golden set of trivial prompts shows tool calls > 0 and p95 over budget
rules.fixHint: tool_choice auto; let the model decide

rules.title: Whole request/response/payload logged
rules.why: Log volume grows with payload size and leaks personal data and secrets.
rules.confirm: measurement: log bytes per request under load over the budget
rules.fixHint: log selected fields with a size cap

rules.title: findMany() with no arguments (unbounded read)
rules.why: Reads every row; cost grows with the user's data on every call.
rules.confirm: measurement: endpoint time at 1x, 10x, 100x seeded rows grows linearly or worse
rules.fixHint: take + cursor (keyset pagination), or a justified bound

rules.title: Independent awaits run one after another (waterfall)
rules.why: Each independent call waits for the previous one.
rules.confirm: measurement: server timing shows a serial chain; Promise.all version is faster beyond A/A noise

rules.title: useEffect fetch for first-paint data
rules.why: The data request starts only after JS loads and hydrates.
rules.confirm: measurement: LCP on the built app before vs after server rendering the data

rules.title: Loading gate returns a spinner instead of the layout
rules.why: The whole UI blanks while one region waits.
rules.confirm: render: throttled screenshots at 100 ms / 500 ms / 1 s without the shell

rules.title: Async click handler with no pending or optimistic state
rules.why: Nothing happens for seconds; users click again.
rules.confirm: failing-test: delay the request 3 s; assert pending state within 100 ms

rules.title: Performance claim measured on the dev server or with n=1
rules.why: Dev builds are slower and noisier; the number says nothing about what ships.
rules.confirm: measurement: rerun on the built app with >= 10 interleaved runs

rules.title: Lock, queue or single-flight keyed wider than the unit that conflicts (per tenant, per user, global)
rules.why: Independent work waits in one line, so throughput collapses to one item at a time.
rules.confirm: measurement: push N independent items through the path with the current key and with a key per conflicting unit; time per item grows with N only under the current key
rules.fixHint: key the lock by the smallest unit that truly conflicts

rules.title: Fast and slow data behind one loading boundary (a list waits for the slowest panel)
rules.why: Everything shows as late as the slowest source.
rules.confirm: render: delay the slow source 3 s on the built app; a screenshot at 1 s shows the fast content missing
rules.fixHint: one boundary per independent source, shell outside all of them

verify.text: measure the production build and stage, never the dev server
prove the change executes (marker, coverage, or a test that fails on the old code)
Lighthouse CI numberOfRuns >= 5, median, maxNumericValue assertions at level error
1x, 10x, 100x data on each interaction path: no linear-or-worse growth
fresh instance, first request, retries disabled: 10/10
interleaved A/B, n >= 10 per arm, Hodges-Lehmann interval + Cliff's delta, decision rule written before
slow network + 4x CPU: screenshots at 100 ms, 1 s, 3 s show the shell and pending feedback
